summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 20, 2026, updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced April 30, 2026. During the week of October 12–16, 2026, ING repurchased 1,000,000 shares at an average price of €29.96, for €29,960,800.00. Cumulative repurchases total 33,710,805 shares at an average €28.62, or €964,776,200.49, roughly 96.48% of the programme's maximum value. No board recommendation or advisor is cited; shares are cancelled to reduce capital. Watch for programme completion and any successor authorization.
